answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable bond before entering a shared meadow of services, and make that bond slashable when peers prove fake activity. One honest attestation creates a ripple: each newcomer vouched for by a sponsor inherits only a fraction of the sponsor trust, so a single identity cannot spawn an army of clones for free. Every job is signed with a unique quill, a rotating key derived from the stake, tying each action to one accountable wallet; splitting identities multiplies the capital at risk instead of multiplying free rewards.
